map.title: Frozen virtual world coordinates — XY review map

pass_conditions: 012 result, coordinate-state, and source-model hashes match
the map labels baseframe, default gripperframe projection, table bounds, cup, barrier, two fixed cameras, two review cameras, and +X/+Y directions from the frozen state
the PNG artifact exists and is nonuniform
non_claims: This is a labeled 2D projection of frozen virtual coordinates, not a physical survey, calibration image, perception result, collision map, or reachability proof.
The default gripperframe marker is a static model reference only; it is not a side-grasp target pose.
